title: Dynamics of Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Near a Manifold of Flat Minima
abstract: arXiv:2607.08380v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An important quantity in the theory of gradient descent (GD) is the \emph{sharpness}, defined as the largest eigenvalue of the objective Hessian. Classical analyses typically require the step size to be uniformly smaller than twice the reciprocal of the sharpness, but this condition is frequently violated in the training of deep neural networks. Recent work bridges this gap in the setting of overparametrised least-squares with a \emph{single scalar output}, providing a normal form for large-step GD in a neighbourhood of an \emph{isolated} flat minimum and establishing three corresponding convergence results. In this paper, we extend this theory in two directions: (1) to overparametrised least-squares with \emph{vector-valued outputs} (including regression with arbitrarily many observations), and (2) to a neighbourhood of a \emph{manifold} of flat minima (which we show is essential for applications such as matrix factorisation). translated_title: 大步长梯度下降在平坦极小值流形附近的动力学
translated_abstract: 梯度下降（GD）理论中的一个重要量是“锐度”（sharpness），其定义为目标函数Hessian矩阵的最大特征值。经典分析通常要求步长一致地小于锐度倒数的两倍，但这一条件在深度神经网络的训练中经常被违反。最近的工作在具有“单标量输出”的过参数化最小二乘设置中弥合了这一差距，为“孤立”平坦极小值邻域内的大步长梯度下降提供了规范形式（normal form），并建立了三个相应的收敛结果。在本文中，我们将这一理论向两个方向进行扩展：（1）扩展到具有“向量值输出”的过参数化最小二乘问题（包括具有任意多观测值的回归）；（2）扩展到“平坦极小值流形”的邻域（我们证明了这一扩展对于矩阵分解等应用是必不可少的）。
tldr: 本文将大步长梯度下降在平坦极小值附近的收敛理论从单标量输出的孤立平坦极小值情形，扩展到向量值输出情形以及平坦极小值流形邻域情形，其中后者对矩阵分解等应用至关重要。
